description: This file is a shell scriptlet intended to be sourced by other shell scripts to set up functions for working with Git merge tools. It defines functions such as get_merge_tool, get_merge_tool_cmd, get_merge_tool_path, initialize_merge_tool, and run_merge_tool, which facilitate interaction with Git merge tools based on the TOOL_MODE variable.

methods.name: get_merge_tool
methods.description: Returns a merge tool, indicating if a guessed tool was used.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_cmd
methods.description: Returns the custom command for a specified merge tool.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Returns the custom path for a specified merge tool.

methods.name: initialize_merge_tool
methods.description: Sets up merge tool specific functions for use or override.

methods.name: run_merge_tool
methods.description: Launches a merge tool with given parameters and environment variables.
